about: Chord-reading corpus for arsenal/web/piano/chordread.js (theory-nextgen-spec 2.6, TN0; frozen after TN0, changes go through the conductor). Scored by tests/theory_chordread.test.mjs (NG1, NG3) and, for parity, by the practice lane (NG15). Expected names are written by hand from lead-sheet convention, the spec's tables and the jam deck text, never from either engine; transposed cases move Daniel's 24 voicings to the other 11 major keys, with names and prev moved by the same interval. Synthetic voicings only: no session content.

conventions.notes: note names with octave, C4 = MIDI 60; the reader gets the MIDI numbers in this order
conventions.key: a key name nashville.js parseKey reads, passed to read() as opts.key; null means no key
conventions.prev: the chord before; its root pitch class is read() opts.prev.root; null means none
conventions.match: names match by identity: root pitch class, suffix exactly, bass pitch class (nashville.js parseChord), so enharmonic spellings of one chord match
conventions.right: the top reading's identity is expect.name or one of expect.accept; exact: it is expect.name; a result whose kind is not chord shows letters and names nothing
conventions.band_max: the expected band ceiling (spec 2.6): the band is this one or less sure (later in band_order). Written by hand: clear where the notes carry one plain name; leaning where the same notes carry a second name as plain on another root or bass (C6 and Am7/C), a no-3rd reading, or the gospel 5 over 4 against the Lydian 4. Every named case of the prototype, transposed, defect and chip groups writes one, and the tag-only quartal voicing writes leaning
conventions.also: the expected canvas ALSO (spec 2.6, D5): alsoOf(result, templateInfo, 1000) with templateInfo = the pre-build Theory.detect(notes, key bias), as a name or null for none. Written by hand as today's page name when it names the same notes fairly on another root or bass, else null. Asserted when the top reading is expect.name (an accepted top has its own ALSO); non-strict cases match by identity, strict cases by spelling. Every named case of the prototype, transposed, defect and chip groups writes one; transposed cases move it with the notes
conventions.close: closeOf(result, 1000): its name, or null for none
conventions.number: nashville.js text of expect.name in the key with any (no3) removed (the number drawn beside it), or null
conventions.include: a reading with this identity is among the first `within` readings
conventions.exclude: no reading has this identity (any_bass: root and suffix only)
conventions.strict: every assertion of the case must hold (defect, chip and also-lab cases)
conventions.tags: voicing tags that must be present; tags_absent must not be

groups.prototype: the 73 voicings of design-engine 5 (71 named, 2 tag-only); NG1: at least 71 right, 67 exact, groups plain 32/32, daniel 24/24, dominant 10/10, voicing 5/5, tags 6/6, cluster tag on at most 4 of the daniel 24
groups.transposed: Daniel's 24 in the other 11 major keys; NG1: identical numbers in every key
groups.also-lab: spec 2.1 lab table; NG3: exactly as the table
groups.chip: the suggestion chips' voicings read as themselves; NG1: 100%
groups.seed: every distinct slot of the 17 seed cards (jam-spec 12) in its card key, prev = the slot before
